verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution sends stack trace, environment and affected-code context to an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) and returns suggestions on the root cause and how to fix the error. Teams can discuss these in a collaborative chat and post a link to the conversation as an error comment. GitHub, Bitbucket and GitLab integrations exist, but nothing shows the AI writing a code patch or opening a pull request for review. Missing for 10: AI-generated code patch/diff, automated pull request creation against the connected repo, a human-review workflow for that PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
